description: Interview you and help you build your dream AI persona faster.

defaultPrompt: I signed up on Gabriel Operator and connected my Gabi token. Create a persona from this description.
Define lists, pipeline stages, and chat copy for this persona.
Draft a team-agent workflow for this Gabriel persona.
interface.longDescription:
Tell this plugin what your AI persona should do. It asks a few questions, then builds a complete end-to-end persona on Gabriel Operator: research, tools, prepared actions, your approval, then the real workflow. Ready to chat, try, and improve - not a stack of disconnected agents.

Please Sign up at https://gabrieloperator.com/signup. Open Workspace, go to Dashboard, and copy your Gabi token (the key that starts with gabi_). Connect that token in ChatGPT before you run this plugin. Do not paste the raw token into chat.

name: gabriel-operator
